notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
We have released Patch 1.0.1 to improve your gaming experience.

Please apply the latest update files before playing.

Improvements

The language selection displayed when starting a new game has been corrected from “日本語” and “英語” to ‘日本語’ and “English”.

We will continue making improvements to ensure you can enjoy Okayu Nyuuum! more comfortably.

We appreciate your continued support.
